review_comments.body: **Required HTTP test is missing** These cases only test `ToOpenAIResponsesRequest` directly. `AGENTS.md` requires a provider-harness case alongside every wire-visible change. Add a replay case that checks the required `id` and `status` through the HTTP route against a strict backend. The existing source-round-trip case does not check those fields. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/005438f1bf46f2c7774de76dbb6bf4990b317fce/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Request cost is not measured** This adds `isNativeWebSearchCall` checks inside the input loop, but the PR provides no cost measurements. `AGENTS.md` requires request-path changes to include a benchmark and before/after `allocs/op` and `ns/op` results. Extend `BenchmarkResponsesInputToOpenAIRequest` coverage for ordinary input and web-search history, then record the results. This repository requirement must be satisfied before merging. **File Used:** `AGENTS.md` ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/005438f1bf46f2c7774de76dbb6bf4990b317fce/AGENTS.md)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Replay payload breaks construction rule** The capture script parses a provider response and uses `JSON.stringify(call)` to build the next request. This violates the repository directive that E2E payloads use direct object literals, not JSON round trips. The request inherits the returned object's fields and ordering instead of declaring them explicitly. Build the replay item from an explicit literal, copying the captured `id`, `status`, and required search fields in the intended order. **Rule Used:** E2E API payloads must be constructed directly as object literals. Do not serialize through maps, Records, Object.fromEntries, or JSON round trips because field order matters. ([source](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/blob/76119fd8030012d342d1bacfa5ba4ac938a84164/.greptile/config.json)) Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Require web search in the capture request.** If the model answers without using the optional search tool, the capture case fails because `output` has no `web_search_call`. The replay case then has no call to send. Set `tool_choice` to `"required"` so the live test exercises the behavior it asserts. OpenAI documents that search is optional with automatic tool choice. ([developers.openai.com](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-web-search?utm_source=openai))
